def remove_Occ(s, ch):
    first = s.find(ch)
    if first == -1:
        return s
    last = s.rfind(ch)
    # remove first occurrence
    s = s[:first] + s[first+1:]
    if last != first:
        # last index shifts left by one after removing the first char
        last -= 1
        s = s[:last] + s[last+1:]
    return s
